cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(retained_consumer LANGUAGES C)
find_package(LeanBridgeLbcCRetained CONFIG REQUIRED)
find_package(LeanBridgeLbcCPeer CONFIG REQUIRED)
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
add_executable(consumer consumer.c)
set_target_properties(consumer PROPERTIES C_STANDARD 11 C_STANDARD_REQUIRED YES C_EXTENSIONS NO)
target_compile_options(consumer PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror)
target_link_libraries(consumer PRIVATE LeanBridge::lbc_c_retained LeanBridge::lbc_c_peer Threads::Threads ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS})
